Single pulse example 1:
Channel nr: 2, binary value (010) == (Physical channel nr 3)
Pulse Width: 200, binary (011001000)
Pulse Amplitude: 120, binary (1111000)

Checksum:2+200+120 = 322 binary (101000010) (Channel Nr + PulseWidth + Current)
checksum:  5 LSB/Modulo 32) (00010)

           
Byte 0 -- 1 11 00010  --- (1) start bit, (11) command identity, (00010) checksum
Byte 1 -- 0 010 xx 01 --- (0) start bit, (01) channel nr. ,(010) Pulse Width 2 MSB 
                00 (2 bits not in use)  
byte 2 -- 0 1001000   --- (0) start bit, (1001000) PW 7 LSB
Byte 3 -- 0 1111000   --- (0) start bit (1111000) Current


Byte code (HEX)  E2 21 48 78

                   
Return value (HEX) C1 -OK      (11 00000 1) (11) Ident Number, (1) Ok 
	           C0 -> Not Ok(11 00000 0) (11) Ident Number, (0) Not Ok 

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Single pulse example 2:

Channel nr: 5 -- binary value (101) 3 bits
Pulse Width 221 -- binary value (011011101)  9 bits
Pulse Amplitude 55 -- binary value (0110111) 7 bits

Chechsum= Pulsewidth+current+ channel nr= 221+55+5=281 --binary (100011001)
Chechsum: mod(281,32)= 25 -- binary (11001) 5 bits

byte 0 - 1 11 11001  --- (1) start bit, (11) command identity, (11001) checksum
byte 1 - 0 101 00 01 --- (0) start bit, (01) channel nr. ,(101) Pulse Width 2 MSB
byte 2 - 0 1011101   --- (0) start bit, (1011101) PW 7 LSB
byte 3 - 0 0110111   --- (0) start bit, (0110111) Current


Byte code (HEX): F9 51 5D 37

Return value (HEX) C1 -OK      (11 00000 1) ---- (11) Ident Number, (1) Ok
	           C0 -> Not Ok(11 00000 0) ---- (11) Ident Number, (0) Not Ok
